# Daily Report — 2026-09-19

## Task Completed
Added `list_service_offerings` and `get_service_offering` tools for the `service_offering` table.

- `list_service_offerings` — paginated listing with filters for name (substring), state (operational/pipeline/retired), active (boolean), and service_classification (substring)
- `get_service_offering` — single-record lookup by sys_id or exact name with 404 guard
- `_format_service_offering` normalises 24 fields including reference fields (business_contact, it_contact, owned_by, managed_by, parent, portfolio)
- `_resolve_service_offering_sys_id` helper — passthrough for 32-char hex sys_ids, name→sys_id lookup otherwise
- Registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages
